guitar.notes: Dimebag Darrell's Dean ML "Dean from Hell" and later Washburn Dime signature are iconic and well documented; entry accurate.

tone.target: Dimebag-style tight scooped thrash crunch with pinch-harmonic bite
tone.profile: Dimebag-style tight scooped thrash crunch with pinch-harmonic bite
tone.summary: A modern metal/thrash rig using a high-gain amp (Recti) combined with distortion and EQ to achieve the signature tight, scooped, harmonic-rich sound of Dimebag Darrell.
corrections: Name the Dimebag riff tone, not generic mid-gain
Add pinch-harmonic squeal and aggressive upper bite
Keep it dry and tighter than Recto-style modern metal

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum.
Aggressively boost the signal for maximum saturation and bite.
blocks.gap: A dedicated high-gain pre-boost (like an OD or Boost) is needed to push the amp into aggressive territory.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core high-gain saturation and aggressive crunch required for thrash metal.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is used to simulate a tight, saturated bridge humbucker sound without excessive mud.

blocks.purpose: Achieve the signature scooped mids and bright upper-harmonic bite.
Simulate the solid-state high-gain power section needed for modern metal tightness.
blocks.gap: The Recti model is ideal for tight, aggressive low-end response, avoiding 'Mesa recto mud'.

blocks.purpose: Provide a focused, dry, close-miked sound that emphasizes attack and bite.
blocks.gap: The Vintage cab is chosen for its punchy response suitable for aggressive tones.

blocks.purpose: Minimal ambience/slight echo for depth without muddying the tight tone.
blocks.gap: The effect is kept minimal and mostly bypassed to maintain maximum dryness, as requested.

blocks.purpose: Minimal room ambience; kept off to maintain the dry, aggressive close-mic feel.
blocks.gap: The effect is bypassed entirely to meet the 'dry' requirement.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better attack and bite, crucial for Dimebag's signature harmonic squeal.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper harmonics and bite for aggressive thrash tone.
proposals.whenToUse: After initial testing of the GP-180 preset
